task: MEDIA-284: Anonymous requests to /teams/west/drafts/badge.png return the image. That draft must not be public. /teams/west/badge.png should remain available, and files under west/private are already inaccessible. Please fix the asset visibility decision.
protected_why: Any path segment beginning with a dot is private, including a team name, because deployment tooling stores operational assets there.
